steps.title: Paragraph Burger
say: Hi! I'm Chef Patty. Today we are building a PARAGRAPH BURGER!
A good paragraph is built just like a hamburger.
TOP BUN = the topic sentence. It tells what the whole paragraph is about.
FILLINGS = detail sentences. Each one tells one more fact about the topic.
BOTTOM BUN = the closing sentence. It wraps everything up.

steps.title: Level 1
say: LEVEL 1: Build the Burger!
I'll show you sentences from a paragraph about WOLVES. You tell me which part of the burger each one is.
Every right answer adds a layer to the burger in front of you.

steps.sentence: A wolf pack works together to hunt.
steps.prompt: Which part of the burger is this?
steps.hint: Does it tell the BIG idea of the whole paragraph, or just one fact about wolves? One fact = a filling!
steps.praise: Yes! That's one fact about wolves, so it's a filling. Here comes the patty!

steps.sentence: Wolves are amazing animals that live in packs.
steps.prompt: Which part of the burger is this?
steps.hint: This one tells the BIG idea: what the whole paragraph is about. Big idea = top bun!
steps.praise: Yes! It tells what the whole paragraph is about. That's the top bun!

steps.sentence: Wolves howl to talk to each other.
steps.prompt: Which part of the burger is this?
steps.hint: Is it the big idea, or one small fact about wolves?
steps.praise: Another fact, another filling. Cheese, please!

steps.sentence: That is why wolves are some of the coolest animals in the wild.
steps.prompt: Which part of the burger is this?
steps.hint: Look at the words "That is why". Words like that wrap things up at the END.
steps.praise: Yes! "That is why" wraps it all up. That's the bottom bun!

steps.sentence: Wolf pups are born blind and stay close to their mom.
steps.prompt: Which part of the burger is this?
steps.hint: Is this the big idea, or one more fact about wolves?
steps.praise: Last filling! Here's the lettuce. Your burger is DONE!

say: Look at your burger! Now read the paragraph from top to bottom:

Wolves are amazing animals that live in packs. A wolf pack works together to hunt. Wolves howl to talk to each other. Wolf pups are born blind and stay close to their mom. That is why wolves are some of the coolest animals in the wild.
Top bun, three fillings, bottom bun. That's a paragraph!

steps.title: Level 2
say: LEVEL 2: Find the Imposter!
Every sentence in a paragraph has to be about the topic.
But one sneaky sentence snuck in! Click the sentence that does NOT belong.

steps.prompt: Topic: HORSES. Which sentence is the imposter?
options: Horses eat hay, grass, and apples.
My favorite pizza has extra cheese.
A baby horse is called a foal.
steps.hint: Ask yourself about each one: is this about HORSES? The one that isn't is the imposter.
steps.praise: Busted! Pizza is yummy, but it's not about horses.

steps.prompt: Topic: CREEPERS. Which sentence is the imposter?
options: Creepers are green and make a hissing sound.
I scored two goals at my soccer game.
Creepers explode when they get close to you.
steps.hint: Which sentence is NOT about creepers?
steps.praise: Boom! Soccer is fun, but it's not about creepers.

steps.prompt: Topic: FALL. This one is trickier! Which sentence is the imposter?
options: In the fall, leaves turn red, orange, and yellow.
We pick pumpkins at the farm in October.
Sharks have many rows of sharp teeth.
It gets colder, so we wear jackets.
steps.hint: Three sentences are about the fall season. One is about something else. Which one?
steps.praise: Chomp! Sharks are cool, but they're not about fall. You're an imposter hunter!

steps.title: Level 3
say: LEVEL 3: Put It in Order!
Some paragraphs tell HOW to do something. Clue words help you know the order: First, Next, Then, Finally.
Here's the topic sentence: "Taming a wolf in Minecraft is easy if you follow these steps."

options: Then, right-click the wolf with bones until it gets a red collar.
First, find a wolf in a forest.
Finally, your new pet will follow you everywhere!
Next, get some bones from skeletons.
steps.hint: Look for the clue word that means "number one".

options: Then, right-click the wolf with bones until it gets a red collar.
First, find a wolf in a forest.
Finally, your new pet will follow you everywhere!
Next, get some bones from skeletons.
steps.hint: You already found "First". Which clue word comes after that?
steps.praise: Right! You need bones before you can tame it.

options: Then, right-click the wolf with bones until it gets a red collar.
First, find a wolf in a forest.
Finally, your new pet will follow you everywhere!
Next, get some bones from skeletons.
steps.hint: First, Next, ... what's the next clue word?

steps.prompt: Which sentence is the CLOSING sentence?
options: Then, right-click the wolf with bones until it gets a red collar.
First, find a wolf in a forest.
Finally, your new pet will follow you everywhere!
Next, get some bones from skeletons.
steps.hint: Which clue word means "the last one"?
steps.praise: "Finally" means it's the end. Perfect order!

say: Here's your whole paragraph, in order:

Taming a wolf in Minecraft is easy if you follow these steps. First, find a wolf in a forest. Next, get some bones from skeletons. Then, right-click the wolf with bones until it gets a red collar. Finally, your new pet will follow you everywhere!
Remember those steps. You'll need them soon...

steps.title: Level 4
say: LEVEL 4: Build It, Then Write It!
1. Build ANYTHING you want: a house, a farm, a secret base, a trap. Your choice!
2. Then open the book I gave you and write a paragraph about your build. Use the burger: 1 topic sentence, 3 detail sentences, 1 closing sentence.
3. When you're done writing, click the button.
Let's check your burger before we serve it!
steps.prompt: Does your FIRST sentence tell what the whole paragraph is about?
steps.hint: That's OK! Open your book and fix your first sentence. Then click Yes!

steps.prompt: Do you have 3 DETAIL sentences, each one telling something about your build?
steps.hint: Add a detail! What does your build look like? What is it for? What's the coolest part?

steps.prompt: Does your LAST sentence wrap it all up?
steps.hint: Try starting your last sentence with "That is why" or "I love my build because".

steps.prompt: Is every sentence about your build? No imposters?
steps.hint: Read each sentence and ask: is this about my build? Cross out any imposters.

say: Your paragraph burger is ready to serve. You are officially a PARAGRAPH CHEF!
Here's a reward: some diamonds, some bones, and a wolf. Remember the steps to tame it!
Don't forget to show your book to a grown-up.
